name: smooth-scroll
title: 平滑滚动 Smooth Scroll
description: 用 Lenis 为页面或自定义容器提供惯性平滑滚动基座。

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the Lenis context or custom scroll container.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable interpolation while preserving the content wrapper.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Respect the operating system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: root
props.description:
Setup a global instance of Lenis
if `asChild`, the component will render wrapper and content divs

usage:
`SmoothScroll` 封装 Lenis 官方 React Provider。默认 `root` 模式接管文档滚动；设置 `root={false}` 可渲染独立滚动容器。`options` 会直接传给 Lenis，并默认开启 `autoRaf`。

按照 Lenis 官方建议，在应用入口引入配套样式：

```tsx
import "lenis/dist/lenis.css"
```
